title: Depot turnaround time before and after the revised intake rota: a two-site service evaluation

exhibits.label: table_01
exhibits.caption: Table 1. Median turnaround time by site and rota period, with the proportion of units meeting the four-hour standard
exhibits.notes: IQR, interquartile range. The four-hour standard is the depot's own service target, not a regulatory one. Site B did not operate a weekend intake in the before period, so no weekend figure is reported for it.

summary: A two-site service evaluation of depot turnaround time before and after a revised intake rota. Turnaround fell at both sites, and the proportion of units meeting the four-hour standard rose at both, though the weekend comparison is available for one site only.
